verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a data-export feature, such as exporting flows, tables, run history or connections in open formats, or any documented offboarding path. The MIT/open-source status, self-hosting and a general API are adjacent building blocks rather than an export capability, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
